summary: More ansible-core 2.19 deprecations: the bool filter coercing unrecognized values (consider truthy and falsy tests), ansible.plugins.cache.base, the v2_on_any and v1 callback methods, conditionals with {{ }} delimiters, and config options with no effect: ACTION_WARNINGS, DEFAULT_ALLOW_UNSAFE_LOOKUPS, DEFAULT_JINJA2_NATIVE and DEFAULT_NULL_REPRESENTATION.
questions: Why do I get a warning for {{ }} in when conditions?
Is the bool filter deprecated for None?
What replaces v2_on_any in callback plugins?

answer_card.title: Don't use {{ }} in conditionals
answer_card.answer_md:
Write conditionals as bare expressions:

```yaml
when: my_var == 'x'        # good
when: "{{ my_var == 'x' }}" # deprecated
```

Delimiters are only allowed when the whole value is one template that resolves to a trusted string expression.
